# CU Blog Service at Cornell

> > A Cornell University blogging platform powered by WordPress with institutional authentication and support services.

The CU Blog Service is Cornell University's hosted WordPress blogging platform that enables faculty, staff, and students to create and manage blogs using Cornell NetID authentication. The platform provides centralized support and documentation for users of the blog service.

## Key Topics

- CU Blog Service
- WordPress
- Cornell NetID
- Shibboleth
- Authentication
- Blog Platform
- Cornell University

## Authentication & Access

- [Log In › CU Blog Service — WordPress](https://blogs.cornell.edu/wp-login.php): WordPress login page for CU Blog Service using Cornell NetID authentication
